meta.name: kubernetes-skill
meta.description: Prevent Kubernetes hallucinations by diagnosing and fixing failure modes: insecure workload defaults, resource starvation, network exposure, privilege sprawl, fragile rollouts, and API drift. Use when generating, reviewing, refactoring, or migrating manifests, Helm charts, Kustomize overlays, cluster policies, and platform-specific Kubernetes work for EKS, GKE, AKS, OpenShift, GitOps controllers, or observability stacks.

copy.tagline: 诊断并修复 Kubernetes 配置中的故障模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果管理 Kubernetes 集群并需要确保配置安全可靠。
